notes.en: Known URLs use advanced Extract. Search finds pages from a query, Crawl follows linked pages, and Research generates answers; none replaces text from the target URL. Resource tasks enable include_images, but the API has no original-file or video-download output. The 45-second outer limit reserves time for persistence, leaving 40.5 seconds for client and server extraction. HTTP 200 without raw_content remains an adapter-level request failure; raw responses remain private hash-bound evidence.
